note: Per-manager storylines for COMPLETED seasons. Keyed by season -> stable Sleeper ownerId. Static archive (past results never change); the history page joins these to history.json standings for author/finish/record. Regenerate/extend with scripts/generate-season-stories.mjs.

1134715278987943936.headline: One Nut Barner ran the table at 11-3 with a league-best 2100.28 points and STILL watched someone else hoist the trophy.
1134715278987943936.detail: 11-3 and 2100.28 points for is a #1 seed résumé, but the postseason doesn't care about your regular season — ask anyone who finished this year staring at 3rd place with a ring instead.

1132877923033391104.headline: Bubble Guts led the ENTIRE LEAGUE in points scored with 2201.20 and still couldn't crack the top spot at 8-6.
1132877923033391104.detail: Most points for in Busters Anonymous, yet a pedestrian 8-6 record and a runner-up finish — that's what happens when your points-against (2128.38) keeps pace right behind you.

474461892971065344.headline: Milk Magnus backed into a 7-7 record and somehow walked out with the RING — the ultimate proof that fantasy football doesn't grade on style points.
474461892971065344.detail: 2138.66 points for against a mediocre .500 record didn't stop the Megamind from claiming his first title in two seasons — first career ring, and now nobody can call him just Milk Man anymore... probably.

1116599370310356992.headline: The African Bald Fraud lived up to the name — 7-7, and somehow still got outscored on the year (1988.20 for vs 2092.14 against).
1116599370310356992.detail: A negative point differential and a coin-flip record is exactly the Bald Fraud brand: never quite good, never quite bad, always just there.

1127784442816344064.headline: The Shake n Bakers shook more than they baked, limping to a 6-7-1 finish despite 2094.50 points that should've bought a better seat.
1127784442816344064.detail: Fifth place with a losing-adjacent record and points-against (2109.74) that outpaced their offense — a season that never quite got in the oven long enough.

1132905719180943360.headline: The Ultimate Light Skin actually posted the best point differential in the bottom half of the league (2047.04 for, 1884.08 against) — and still finished 6th at 6-7-1.
1132905719180943360.detail: Outscoring opponents by over 160 points and still stuck below .500 is the definition of getting robbed by the schedule.

1132933728533270528.headline: The Alaskan Bull Worm slithered to a 5-9 record despite dropping 2139.28 points — the definition of all bark, zero bite. 🏔️🪱
1132933728533270528.detail: Fourth-most points scored in the entire league (2139.28) but a bottom-two record and a whopping 2262.48 against — the schedule and the defense both ate this worm alive.

784624291579854848.headline: Thicks brought up the rear at 5-9 with the league's lowest point total (1767.88) — a far cry from the title he won just a season ago.
784624291579854848.detail: A former champion reduced to dead last with the fewest points for AND a bottom-tier scoring defense (2008.06 against) — Sticks to Thicks to 8th place, quite the fall.

1132933728533270528.headline: btkempski topped the standings at 10-4 with a league-best 1810.82 points, and yet he still couldn't slither past the bracket to grab the ring.
1132933728533270528.detail: The Alaskan Bull Worm 🏔️🪱 put up the gaudiest numbers in the building all year, but finishing 1st in the regular season and 1st on the trophy shelf are two very different animals.

1134715278987943936.headline: 9-5 and 1737.3 points and adambarner111 STILL walks away with nothing to show for it.
1134715278987943936.detail: Across two seasons this dude is a ridiculous 20-8, but One Nut Barner's career average finish of 1.5 just took a gut punch — runner-up isn't the résumé he signed up for.

784624291579854848.headline: Tyrique14 finished 3rd in the standings, got outscored on the season, and still hoisted the trophy — that's not luck, that's CLUTCH.
784624291579854848.detail: 9-5 with 1643.38 points-for against 1656.28 against means the #FreeMaxx Champions were mathematically worse than half this league on paper, but titles aren't won on paper — Thicks is now a certified ring-holder.

1116599370310356992.headline: mjwithgoldhoops dropped a league-leading 1860.68 points and got REWARDED with a 4th place finish — the schedule owes this man an apology.
1116599370310356992.detail: 8-6 with the single highest points-for total in the entire league is the definition of getting fantasy-football mugged; the African Bald Fraud earned a title shot and got a participation trophy instead.

1132905719180943360.headline: BigBoiEmos split the difference at 7-7, proving the Ultimate Light Skin is allergic to both greatness and disaster.
1132905719180943360.detail: 1756.62 points-for was solidly middle-of-the-pack production for a middle-of-the-pack 5th place finish — the definition of treading water.

1132877923033391104.headline: briangalvan1 finished dead even at 7-7 and somehow that felt like the ceiling all year for Bubble Guts.
1132877923033391104.detail: 1686.38 points-for against 1677.78 against is about as coin-flip as a season gets — the Peacemakers made peace with mediocrity.

1265145602090483712.headline: tristanthepiston debuted at 7-7 and immediately earned his half of the Bald Fraud crown.
1265145602090483712.detail: 1581.02 points-for was the lowest of any .500 team in the league, proof the Mexican Bald Fraud backed into wins he didn't really deserve.

474461892971065344.headline: Alxgalvn's big brain produced an 8th-place 6-8 finish that no amount of scheming could fix.
474461892971065344.detail: 1563.52 points-for and 1662.42 against shows a defending-caliber roster (career avg finish 5.5, one title in the bank) that just got outscored into oblivion this year — Milk Man went sour.

1264710608129884160.headline: parkcity0613 fled to the middle of the pack and still landed in 9th at 6-8.
1264710608129884160.detail: 1549.46 points-for barely edged out the bottom tier — this DPRK defector traded one hard regime for a fantasy team that offered no asylum from losses.

1265163251033849856.headline: Pharaoh23 chose the hard way and got exactly that: a 6-8 finish and 10th place misery.
1265163251033849856.detail: 1509.12 points-for and 1553 against means Auntie Thomas wasn't even competitive most weeks — the hard way was also the losing way.

1265186290593189888.kicker: PRINCE OF PERSIA, PAUPER OF THE STANDINGS
1265186290593189888.headline: SwooshAnoosh limped to a 5-9 finish that left the Prince dethroned before Thanksgiving.
1265186290593189888.detail: 1464.48 points-for was the second-worst in the league, and 1569.48 against sealed an 11th-place fate that no video-game respawn could fix.

1265060864969424896.headline: talentedtenthh finished dead last at 4-10 and got outscored by a brutal 265+ points on the year.
1265060864969424896.detail: 1430.42 points-for against 1696.02 against is the ugliest differential in the league — Chauncey wasn't just bad, he was historically overwhelmed.
